sections.heading: 1. General
paragraphs: This policy is a part of the Terms and conditions of [SELLER LEGAL NAME]. Paddle.com is the Merchant of Record for our orders and makes the refunds.

sections.heading: 2. Subscriptions
paragraphs: You can cancel a subscription at any time. Access stays until the end of the paid period, and the next charge is not made.
You can ask for a refund of a subscription payment within [REFUND PERIOD] days of the payment.
When you move to another plan, the unused part of the period of the old plan is credited or refunded automatically.

sections.heading: 3. Credits and one-time purchases
paragraphs: You can ask for a refund of unused credits within [REFUND PERIOD] days of the purchase. Spent credits are not refunded.
Voluntary donations are not refunded, except for a payment made by mistake.

sections.heading: 4. Consumers in the EU and the UK
paragraphs: If you are a consumer, you have a legal right to withdraw from a purchase within 14 days without a reason. This right ends when the supply of the digital service has started with your express consent and your acknowledgement that you lose the right.

sections.heading: 5. How to request a refund
paragraphs: Write to [EMAIL] from the address of your account, with the date and the amount of the payment, or use the link in the receipt from Paddle.
The money returns to the payment method that you used. The time of the credit depends on your bank.
